newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Sept 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Sept 13.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company
The Labour party has launched a major damage limitation exercise, following claims that Tony Blair is considering breaking the party's historical links with the trade unions.
MARKETS WATCH FOR KEY U.S. RATE SIGNALS
The markets are expectantly waiting for key economic data which could determine the Federal Reserve's next interest rate move.
ABBEY LIFE BACKS NURSING HOME MERGERS

Abbey Life has emerged as an important backer of consolidation in the nursing homes industry. It is a 4.3 percent shareholder in Takare and 14.1 percent shareholder in Cavendish, the two nursing homes operators which last week announced a 250 million stg merger.
GM READY TO CUT ITS COSTS WITH LIFETIME JOBS OFFER

General Motors is offering its ageing workforce Japanese-style lifetime jobs guarantees, a costly move in the short term, but one which would allow the company to reduce its over-extended labour force as older employees retire.
JARDINE TO TOE CHINA LINE ON CONTAINER PORT
The Jardine group is to defer to Chinese objections, and give up its rights to build two berths in Hong Kong's new 770 million stg Container Terminal 9 project.
